purpose: Review-only source-bound Logs8 standard product and account-compatible Android build recipe
publication: No workflow launch, commit, push, release, or asset upload performed
source_binding: Adjacent plan.json and materializer proofs at execution time; helpers reject unfrozen plans by default and use no hardcoded product/test commits. Test identity/signing already pinned by its overlay and is verified without mutations. Standard product only gets an exact temporary debug signer hook.

local_preflight.scope: Local offline recipe source transforms/restoration, fail-closed guards, job structure, prior accepted DEX utility checks only; no Android build/SDK/device/signature execution claimed

ci_verification_required: Final frozen source materialization and original tests preservation
Complete actual standard product and compatible test Android Kotlin/ARM32/ARM64 compilation
Actual APK DEX/JNI methods, original legacy overloads and public Download bridge
Actual 16KB page packaging and required native libs/assets
Test-only diagnostics present/enabled only in test layer
Exact tracked source restoration and final source proof
verifier_hardening: Independently reconstructed singleton product signer insertion; test changes[] empty; source-proof SHA256 and CI GITHUB_SHA binding enforced.
cache_optimization: Unchanged Logs8 primary keys, ordered proven Android-touch fallback families, safe explicit hit/restore receipt and job summary. Production deps.sh always runs for both layers and remains authoritative for recipe/NDK stamps.
